_scope.brief: art-drop/BRIEF-10.md Part 8 only: six families, eight 48x48 transparent landmarks per family in four seasons.
_scope.review_standard: Good enough to ship beside the approved art; defects judged in grass context at native scale and confirmed at enlarged pixel scale.
checks: Viewed all 192 complete files at nearest-neighbour 8x on checkerboards, with labels outside the 48x48 cells.
Viewed ordered seasonal grass layouts at 1x and family style contexts at 4x, including approved out markers and complete named house references where present.

Viewed six random 8x2 grass layouts at both 1x and 4x. Each has four seasonal panels; each index appears twice per panel. Checked edge collisions, grid/repeat, near-duplicates, silhouettes, noise and palette.

Compared named reference markers, approved out markers, round-2 examples, all seasonal paddies and all eight seasonal grass/plains details on approved base crops. These are comparison material, not additional verdict targets.
Compared the four changed mills directly against the prior versions at 8x and inspected the repairs in current 1x/4x grass layouts.

Checked original PNG dimensions and mode, alpha values, nonempty content, bounding boxes, bottom-centre placement, within-season exact duplicates, clipped edges, blur, antialiasing, fringe/halo, light direction, setting fit, seasonal coherence and winter snow.

not_applicable.3x3_target_base_tiling: Part 8 contains no bases. Approved grass/plains bases were used as comparison and compositing grounds; they are not review targets.
not_applicable.peak_lattice_or_range: Part 8 contains no peaks, so no peak lattice/range or egg-crate verdict applies.
not_applicable.trees_composited_in_forest: Part 8 contains no trees, so forest composites, identical crowns and flat-orange autumn canopies do not apply.
not_applicable.craters_ruins_cyberpunk_ground: Part 8 contains no craters, ruins or opaque cyberpunk ground tiles. Swiss-cheese craters, classical ruins and stamped ground grids are outside this file set.

_scope.technical_result: All 192 targets are nonempty 48x48 RGBA PNGs with binary 0/255 alpha. No within-season exact duplicates. Bottom-centred placement and transparent margins pass. Visual inspection found no clipped edge, fringe, halo, blur, antialiasing or blank winter.
_scope.visual_result: All 192 pass the shipping bar. The four changed mills resolve the prior sail/wall merger. Each family retains eight distinguishable roles and fits its approved palette. Winter snow preserves forms. No new concrete defect was found in the 188 unchanged prior passes. Repetition deliberately introduced by the dense stress panels does not reveal sprite-edge seams or a stamped background; these are sparse landmarks, not continuous terrain.

evidence_key.ordered: Summer, spring, autumn, winter rows; indices 0..7; 1x/4x.
evidence_key.random-8x2: Four seasonal 8-column, 2-row panels per family; every index twice; 1x/4x.
evidence_key.edges-8x: All eight full cells on a checkerboard per family/season; 24 atlases covering every target at 8x.
evidence_key.style-context: Approved out markers, all target seasons and complete house reference where present; 1x/4x.
evidence_key.references: All named family markers and approved out markers; complete house references are on style-context sheets.
evidence_key.all-terrain-details: Approved seasonal grass/plains bases and all details 0..7, plus paddies; 1x/4x.
evidence_key.approved-round2: Approved round-2 buildings and landscape examples; 1x/4x.
evidence_key.fantasy-mills-current-top-prior-bottom: Four seasons left to right; repaired mills above prior versions; 1x/4x/8x.

_scope.out_integrity: All 1304 PNGs in out/ match the pre-review SHA-256 snapshot; no output art was edited.

fantasy.findings: Four revised mills now pass. The red-brown rotor has four separate readable sails in front of the pale wall; the wall remains visible between the lower sails, the hub is distinct, and the darker right wall gives the tower depth. The red matches existing doors and signs rather than introducing a foreign accent. At 1x the rotor is simple but immediately legible; at 8x the edges are clean. Winter keeps roof and doorstep snow without obscuring the mechanism. The 28 unchanged passes retain their distinct well, shrine, stones, tower, waystone, camp and statue silhouettes.

wuxia.findings: All 32 unchanged prior passes retained. Upturned eaves, tiled greys, warm timber and stone agree with the markers and house. The waterwheel has a readable rim, hub and open quadrants. Watchtower supports and ladder remain separate. Stone lantern and statue have distinct silhouettes. Snow sits on roofs and ledges; the camp remains identifiable.

jazz_age.findings: All 32 unchanged prior passes retained. Brick, cream stone and restrained olive match the approved markers. The radial windpump, open watchtower, hand pump, memorial and camp read separately at 1x. The windpump wheel retains negative space and its tail is separate. Winter roof, rim and pedestal caps preserve the underlying structures.

modern.findings: All 32 unchanged prior passes retained. Cream concrete, blue-grey metal and orange accents fit the approved palette. Radio mast, turbine, signpost and sculpture have distinct silhouettes despite their narrow forms. Highlights and shadow planes remain coherent with top-left light. Winter is visibly treated rather than blank, and fine metalwork retains contrast against snow.

scifi.findings: All 32 unchanged prior passes retained. Pale shells, dark supports and cyan accents agree with the approved domes and towers. The bright hologram is a deliberate beacon and remains contained in the silhouette. Shrine, three stones, mast, turbine, beacon, camp and statue are distinguishable. Winter caps preserve the statue limbs and mechanical openings. No stamped ground grid is part of these transparent sprites.

wasteland.findings: All 32 unchanged prior passes retained. Brown scrap and patched surfaces match the approved wasteland markers. The rotor is broad and simple but reads as separate vanes with a tail and open support frame at 1x. The tower, totem, signpost and statue remain distinguishable. Winter is snow on the existing scrap forms, not an empty replacement; rough material edges do not form pale halos.
